rss: How a Chinese-made toy gets to a US retailer
title: Journey of a Toy Brick
story: Toy bricks start far away and travel to your favorite store. Workers in big factories make them, then they ride on ships to get here.
storyBig: Toy bricks are manufactured in large factories and then transported across the ocean to reach local stores. The logistics involve packaging, shipping, and distribution, requiring coordination across multiple businesses.
think: How do you think your favorite toys get to your local store?
bull: Learning about logistics can help businesses deliver toys faster.
bear: Delays can happen if there's too much demand or not enough workers.

rss: US inflation rises more than expected - here's what is happening with prices
title: Prices Going Up! What It Means
story: When prices go up, things cost more. This means a soda or a pizza might be more dollars than before.
storyBig: Inflation causes the prices of goods and services to rise, impacting purchasing power. Families might spend more on everyday items, affecting their overall budget.
think: Why might things cost more money sometimes?
bull: When prices rise, it can mean workers get paid more too.
bear: Higher prices mean people might buy less of their favorite treats.
